subject: Archival retention migration SOW & cost-split for TrustBridge engagement
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: archival retention migration SOW + cost split (TrustBridge)

Team —

We received confirmation from TrustBridge that they can support a managed archival migration for our historical SOC2 evidence and 3rd-party attachments. High level ask: get a firm SOW and pricing, and propose how we split costs between Security budget and Infra/Platform.

Key constraints:
- Scope: migrate 3 years of evidence (~270GB), preserve timestamps and audit hashes.
- Retention policy: some artifacts have 7-year legal retention; others 1–2 years.
- Access model: evidence must remain queryable for compliance team; warm storage ok.

Can Neha own SOW review and cost split recommendation? Marcus / Kim, please flag any infra operational issues or hidden costs (eg. egress, conversion, verification). Rishi, loop in procurement/legal for quick review; we may need expedited redlines.

Attachments: none yet — asking TrustBridge for draft SOW.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Eleanor Briggs <eleanor.briggs@trustbridge.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@trustbridge.io>
Date: 2026-11-24T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: archival retention migration SOW + cost split (TrustBridge)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the note and scope. Attaching a proposed SOW and a retention matrix that maps artifact types to storage tier and estimated hours. Summary:

- Total one-time migration cost: $48,500 (ingest + verification + metadata reconciliation)
- Monthly managed archival storage + query API: $1,250/mo (warm tier)
- Timeline: 6 weeks from kickoff (2-week prep, 3-week ingest, 1-week verification)

Action items we recommend:
1) Confirm list of artifact buckets and any proprietary formats.
2) Provide a primary point-of-contact for verification sampling (suggest Security QA).
3) Approve SOW and we’ll generate a DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: SOW_Archival_Migration_v1.pdf, retention_matrix_202611.xlsx

Happy to walk through the SOW on a quick call if helpful — available Tue/Wed next week.

Best,
Eleanor Briggs
Senior Solutions Engineer
TrustBridge

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Briggs <eleanor.briggs@trustbridge.io>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T11:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: archival retention migration SOW + cost split (TrustBridge)

Eleanor — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. I reviewed the SOW and retention matrix; overall looks reasonable. A few notes and asks before we route to legal:

- Pricing: can you break out the $48.5k into labor vs data transfer vs verification? We need line items for Security and Infra chargebacks.
- Egress: please confirm whether your estimate assumes cross-region egress (we have data in us-east-1 and us-west-2). If there are extra cloud egress fees, we need to capture them.
- Verification: propose sampling plan — Security wants SHA256 checks for a 5% sample, plus full manifest reconciliation. Add that as a deliverable.
- Payments: Redwood prefers Net30 for vendor services unless legal insists on different terms.

Kimberly/Marcus — any red flags on ops impact? Marcus: would a 6-week window with parallelism affect our nightly jobs or cause throttling?

If vendor can add the line-item breakdown and the sampling language, I’ll push to procurement/legal for redlines.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Morgan & Co Legal <legal@morganco.com>
To: Eleanor Briggs <eleanor.briggs@trustbridge.io>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: SOW redlines — TrustBridge archival migration

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Morgan & Co Legal <legal@morganco.com>
To: Eleanor Briggs <eleanor.briggs@trustbridge.io>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:37:00-08:00
Subject: SOW redlines — TrustBridge archival migration

Eleanor —

Attached are our proposed redlines to the SOW. High level changes:
- Indemnity: narrow to data breach caused by TrustBridge negligence; remove overly broad indemnity clauses.
- SLA: add an availability objective for the query API (99.9% monthly).
- Data handling: require return or certified destruction of transferable artifacts on contract termination; add archival handover checklist.
- Audit rights: Redwood requires quarterly audit reports during the first year.

We’ve attached SOW_redlines_MorganCo.docx with tracked changes. If TrustBridge is ok with these, please indicate and we’ll prepare the final for signature.

Regards,
Morgan & Co Legal

[Attachment: SOW_redlines_MorganCo.docx]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Briggs <eleanor.briggs@trustbridge.io>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@trustbridge.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: SOW redlines — TrustBridge archival migration / decision to proceed

Eleanor / Aisha —

Thanks for the updates and the redline intake. We reviewed Morgan & Co’s proposed edits and agree with the changes to indemnity, SLA, and the audit cadence. Confirming Redwood will proceed if TrustBridge accepts the redlines and provides:

- final SOW with line-item breakdown (labor / transfer / verification)
- updated DocuSign envelope (Net30 payment terms)
- attachment of the archival handover checklist and the SHA256 sampling plan

Procurement note: HubSpot deal TB-8472 updated to "SOW approved pending signature" (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8492/TB-8472). Please send final SOW; Legal will aim to review the last pass within 24 hours.

Next steps for us:
- Eleanor: please upload final SOW to DocuSign and share link.
- Neha: prepare verification sampling schedule for kickoff.
- Marcus/Kim: confirm any scheduled maintenance windows that may affect the ingest.

Once DocuSign is sent I’ll approve from my side.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
